environment.description: Staging deployment on ECS Fargate with identical container image including native_processor.node. Split.io SDK configured with workspace API key where 'native-transform-pipeline' targeting rules evaluate to 'off' for all segments via a default rule (kill switch engaged since 2024-01-15 incident). The Split SDK's localhost mode fallback file (.split) is NOT present in the container, so the SDK connects to Split cloud and receives the 'off' treatment. SDK impression listener logs confirm 100% 'off' treatments served in last 30 days. Note: the native_processor.node binary IS loaded and functional in this environment - the code path is gated purely by the Split treatment evaluation.

config.native_addon: native_processor.node compiled with gcc -O2, loaded at startup
config.split_flag_state: native-transform-pipeline = 'off' (kill switch, default rule serves 'off' to all keys)
config.split_sdk_config: cloud mode, no localhost fallback, readyTimeout=5s
config.split_sdk_behavior_on_timeout: returns 'control' treatment (also routes to v1 path since !== 'on')
